title: ui-experience-2.html
content: New Installations Only The picklist now includes a new setting called "Dynamic." Once the Dynamic UI is released, any existing Events using this UI will automatically update to the new look and feel. ( This does not affect upgrades. ) To give Event Organizers and Planners the flexibility to change the {{glossary.user experience}} or look and feel of their s, there are four different {{glossary.user interfaces (UI)}} to choose from. Tabbed UI The Tabbed UI offers the traditional checkout experience for free and paid s. Simple UI The Simple UI is a single-page user interface for only free s. Full-Width UI The Full-Width UI offers an adaptive user experience for free and paid s. Dynamic UI The Dynamic UI offers a contemporary look and feel with streamlined navigation for simple and complex s.
